name: Accursed One
description:
In time immemorial the netherworld bound mortals with cursed rings. When the link to the overworld snapped, most of the damned were recalled.

A few were too angry to go. Those Accursed Ones are still here, rejected by existence. The curses are heavy. The rage hits harder, and the body is harder to put down, but hunger and magic both bite deeper.
